connectors.name: Slack
connectors.description: People mention @OpenBot in Slack channels or send DMs, and your Slack orchestrator routes tasks to the right assistant.
connectors.zhDescription: 在 Slack 频道中提及助手或发送私信，调度助手会自动分配给合适的智能体并在话题中回复。

connectors.name: Discord
connectors.description: Link Discord servers and channels with role-based access control so assistants reply directly in threads.
connectors.zhDescription: 连接 Discord 服务器与频道，支持基于角色的访问控制，在频道与子区中直接回复。

connectors.name: Telegram
connectors.tagline: Groups and private chats in Telegram
connectors.description: Connect Telegram bots, groups, and private chats for bidirectional assistant messaging and workflows.
connectors.zhDescription: 将 Telegram 机器人、群组与私聊桥接到助手工作区，实现双向对话与自动化响应。

connectors.name: WhatsApp
connectors.tagline: Your own chat and people you allow in WhatsApp
connectors.zhTagline: WhatsApp 中你自己的聊天和你允许的人
connectors.description: Pair WhatsApp with sender allowlists, self-chat support, and pairing codes for private assistant access.
connectors.zhDescription: 通过发送者白名单与配对码连接 WhatsApp，支持个人备忘聊天与受控联系人对话。

connectors.name: 1Password
connectors.tagline: Sign in to websites with logins you share
connectors.zhTagline: 用你共享的登录信息登录网站
connectors.description: Zero-exposure credential autofill from your shared 1Password vaults without revealing raw passwords to models.
connectors.zhDescription: 从你共享的 1Password 保管库安全自动填充登录信息与验证码，模型无法看到明文密码。

connectors.name: Bitwarden
connectors.tagline: Sign in to websites with logins from shared folders
connectors.zhTagline: 用共享文件夹中的登录信息登录网站
connectors.description: Authenticate website logins and TOTP codes securely through your shared Bitwarden folders.
connectors.zhDescription: 通过共享文件夹中的 Bitwarden 凭据与两步验证码安全登录网站。

connectors.name: Proton Pass
connectors.tagline: Sign in to websites with logins from shared vaults
connectors.zhTagline: 用共享保管库中的登录信息登录网站
connectors.description: End-to-end encrypted Proton Pass vault connector for masked browser credential submission.
connectors.zhDescription: 端到端加密的 Proton Pass 保管库连接器，支持浏览器自动化安全登录。

connectors.name: X
connectors.tagline: Reply to posts on X with @openbot_ and an agent does the work
connectors.zhTagline: 在 X 上用 @openbot_ 回复帖子，助手就会完成工作
connectors.description: Reply to any post on X mentioning @openbot_ to summarize, translate, draft replies, save notes, or set reminders. Answers wait in your X chat.
connectors.zhDescription: X 会向此服务器添加一个助手，名字也叫 X。在 X 上回复任意帖子并提及 @openbot_，写下你想要的：总结、翻译、起草回复、保存笔记或设置提醒。Chrome 版 OpenBot 扩展程序会读取帖子并发送给 X 助手，你的回复照常发布到 X。回答会在 OpenBot 的 X 聊天中等你。X 助手从不在 X 上发帖、点赞、关注或发送消息。

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.description: Connect GitHub to inspect repositories, triage issues, review pull requests, and trigger workflows via GitHub MCP.
connectors.zhDescription: 连接 GitHub 账号以检索仓库代码、处理 Issue、审查拉取请求并触发自动化工作流。

plugins.name: Aave
plugins.description: Aave helps users explore live Aave V3 and V4 markets, review wallet positions and DAO governance, simulate lending actions, and prepare non-custodial transactions. Every transaction is returned unsigned: the plugin reads the markets and writes the call, and the wallet stays with the user.
plugins.zhDescription: Aave 让用户浏览实时的 Aave V3 和 V4 市场、查看钱包持仓与 DAO 治理、模拟借贷操作，并准备非托管交易。所有交易都以未签名形式返回：插件只读取市场并生成调用，钱包始终掌握在用户手中。

prompts.text: Where can I earn the most on stablecoins across Aave right now?
prompts.zhText: 现在在 Aave 上，稳定币在哪里收益最高？

prompts.text: Which pays more for USDC right now, Aave V3 or V4 on Ethereum?
prompts.zhText: 以太坊上 Aave V3 和 V4 哪个给 USDC 的收益更高？

prompts.text: What's the health factor of 0x0a42b2f3a0d54157dbd7cc346335a4f1909fc02c, and how far from liquidation?
prompts.zhText: 0x0a42b2f3a0d54157dbd7cc346335a4f1909fc02c 的健康因子是多少，距离清算还有多远？

plugins.name: Canva
plugins.description: Canva lets users create and edit designs in words, search their own design library, upload and organize assets, export in the format a channel needs, and leave comments where the work is. Each user signs in to their own Canva account, and the agent can do what that account can do.
plugins.zhDescription: Canva 让用户用文字创建和编辑设计、搜索自己的设计库、上传并整理素材、按渠道需要的格式导出，以及在作品处留下评论。每位用户登录自己的 Canva 账号，助手能做的与该账号一致。

prompts.text: Show me my most recently edited Canva design.
prompts.zhText: 给我看看我最近编辑的 Canva 设计。

prompts.text: Resize my launch poster for Instagram and export both as PNG.
prompts.zhText: 把我的发布海报改成 Instagram 尺寸，并导出两张 PNG。

prompts.text: Turn these release notes into a six-slide Canva presentation.
prompts.zhText: 把这些发行说明做成六页的 Canva 演示文稿。

plugins.name: Linear
plugins.description: Linear lets agents list assigned issues, triage the backlog, update statuses, and draft new issues in the workspace the signed-in account belongs to. Each user signs in to their own Linear account through the browser.
plugins.zhDescription: Linear 让助手列出分配给自己的 Issue、梳理待办、更新状态，并在已登录账号所属的工作区内起草新 Issue。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Linear 账号。

prompts.text: What is assigned to me this week?
prompts.zhText: 这周分配给我的是什么？

prompts.text: Triage the backlog: what is stale, blocked, or missing an owner?
prompts.zhText: 梳理待办：哪些已经搁置、被阻塞或缺少负责人？

prompts.text: File an issue for the crash in the sync queue with reproduction steps.
prompts.zhText: 为同步队列的崩溃建一个 Issue，附上复现步骤。

plugins.name: Notion
plugins.description: Notion lets agents read and write pages, search the workspace, and keep meeting notes and specs where the team already works. Each user signs in to their own Notion account through the browser.
plugins.zhDescription: Notion 让助手读写页面、搜索工作区，并把会议记录和方案放在团队原本工作的地方。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Notion 账号。

prompts.text: Find the current launch spec and summarize the open questions.
prompts.zhText: 找到当前的发布方案，并总结其中的待定问题。

prompts.text: Turn these bullets into a structured meeting note in my team space.
prompts.zhText: 把这些要点整理成团队空间里的结构化会议记录。

prompts.text: Update the onboarding doc with the new release checklist.
prompts.zhText: 用新的发布检查清单更新入职文档。

plugins.name: Obsidian
plugins.description: Obsidian lets agents search, read and write the notes in your vault, so the vault can be their memory. The local server connects to the Local REST API plugin in the Obsidian app on this computer. The plugin's API key is passed to the local server as one environment variable. Keep Obsidian open while agents use it.
plugins.zhDescription: Obsidian 让助手搜索、阅读和写入你仓库中的笔记，让仓库成为它们的记忆。本地服务器连接这台电脑上 Obsidian 应用中的 Local REST API 插件。插件的 API 密钥作为一个环境变量传给本地服务器。助手使用期间请保持 Obsidian 打开。

authFields.label: API key
authFields.hint: In Obsidian, open Settings > Local REST API and copy the API key.

prompts.text: What do my notes say about the decisions on this project?
prompts.zhText: 我的笔记里关于这个项目的决定是怎么写的？

prompts.text: Save this decision as a new note in my vault.
prompts.zhText: 把这个决定作为新笔记保存到我的仓库。

prompts.text: Add a summary of today's work to my Work log note.
prompts.zhText: 把今天工作的总结添加到我的“工作日志”笔记中。

plugins.name: Atlassian
plugins.tagline: Jira work items and Confluence pages
plugins.zhTagline: Jira 工作项与 Confluence 页面
plugins.description: Atlassian lets agents search and read Jira work items, Confluence pages and Bitbucket pull requests, and create or update work items, pages and comments. Each user signs in to their own Atlassian account through the browser and approves the access on a consent screen. Agents get the same permissions as the user: they can change work items and pages, change page permissions, and merge pull requests. Tools that delete Jira data stay off until an organization admin turns them on. Each tool call uses Rovo credits.
plugins.zhDescription: Atlassian 让助手搜索和读取 Jira 工作项、Confluence 页面和 Bitbucket 拉取请求，并创建或更新工作项、页面和评论。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Atlassian 账号，并在授权页面上批准访问。助手拥有与该用户相同的权限：可以修改工作项和页面、修改页面权限，以及合并拉取请求。删除 Jira 数据的工具默认关闭，直到组织管理员将其开启。每次调用工具都会消耗 Rovo 积分。

prompts.text: Which open Jira work items are assigned to me?
prompts.zhText: 哪些未完成的 Jira 工作项分配给了我？

prompts.text: Find the Confluence page about our release process and summarize it.
prompts.zhText: 找到关于我们发布流程的 Confluence 页面并总结。

prompts.text: Create a Jira work item for the login bug with steps to reproduce.
prompts.zhText: 为登录问题创建一个 Jira 工作项，附上复现步骤。

plugins.name: Todoist
plugins.description: Todoist lets agents find tasks by date, text, label or filter, add and reschedule tasks, and manage projects, sections, labels, comments and reminders. Each user signs in to their own Todoist account through the browser. Agents get read and write access: they can change, complete and delete tasks, projects and other items.
plugins.zhDescription: Todoist 让助手按日期、文本、标签或过滤器查找任务，添加任务并重新安排日期，并管理项目、分区、标签、评论和提醒。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Todoist 账号。助手拥有读写权限：可以更改、完成和删除任务、项目及其他条目。

prompts.text: Which Todoist tasks are due today?
prompts.zhText: 今天到期的 Todoist 任务有哪些？

prompts.text: Add these action items to my Todoist Inbox.
prompts.zhText: 把这些待办事项添加到我的 Todoist 收件箱。

prompts.text: Move my overdue Todoist tasks to tomorrow.
prompts.zhText: 把我逾期的 Todoist 任务改到明天。

plugins.name: TickTick
plugins.description: TickTick lets agents search and filter tasks, add and update tasks, and manage lists, sections, folders, tags and comments. Agents can also read and change habits and focus records, and read events from the calendars connected to TickTick. Each user signs in to their own TickTick account through the browser. Agents get read and write access: they can complete, move and delete tasks, and delete tags and focus records.
plugins.zhDescription: TickTick 让助手搜索和筛选任务，添加和修改任务，并管理清单、分组、文件夹、标签和评论。助手还可以读取和修改习惯与专注记录，并读取与 TickTick 关联的日历中的日程。每位用户在浏览器中登录自己的 TickTick 账号。助手获得读写权限：可以完成、移动和删除任务，以及删除标签和专注记录。

prompts.text: Which TickTick tasks are due today?
prompts.zhText: 今天有哪些 TickTick 任务到期？

prompts.text: Add these action items to my TickTick Inbox.
prompts.zhText: 把这些待办事项添加到我的 TickTick 收集箱。

prompts.text: Which TickTick tasks did I complete last week?
prompts.zhText: 我上周完成了哪些 TickTick 任务？

plugins.name: Trello
plugins.description: Trello lets agents search and read boards, lists, cards, checklists and comments, create boards and cards, move lists and cards, mark cards done, and add checklists, comments and labels. Agents can also read and add cards in the user's Trello Inbox, and read Planner events, which can come from a connected Google or Outlook calendar. Each user signs in to their own Trello account through the browser and chooses the workspaces on a consent screen. Agents get the same permissions as the user in those workspaces. They can archive cards and lists, but the server cannot delete anything permanently.
plugins.zhDescription: Trello 让助手搜索和读取看板、列表、卡片、清单和评论，创建看板和卡片，移动列表和卡片，将卡片标记为完成，并添加清单、评论和标签。助手还可以读取和添加用户 Trello 收件箱中的卡片，并读取 Planner 中的日程，这些日程可能来自已连接的 Google 或 Outlook 日历。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Trello 账号，并在授权页面上选择工作区。助手在这些工作区中拥有与用户相同的权限。助手可以归档卡片和列表，但服务器无法永久删除任何内容。

prompts.text: Which Trello cards are assigned to me?
prompts.zhText: 哪些 Trello 卡片分配给了我？

prompts.text: Summarize what is in progress on my Trello board.
prompts.zhText: 总结我的 Trello 看板上正在进行的工作。

prompts.text: Add these action items as cards to my Trello board.
prompts.zhText: 把这些待办事项作为卡片添加到我的 Trello 看板。

plugins.name: Cobrain
plugins.tagline: Shared memory for your AI agents
plugins.description: Cobrain is a Markdown memory that every AI you connect can read and write. Agents load the context of a client or project before working, search past notes and decisions, and save what they learn so the next thread starts where the last one ended. Each user signs in to their own Cobrain account.
plugins.zhDescription: Cobrain 是一份 Markdown 记忆，你连接的每个 AI 都可以读取和写入。助手开工前会加载客户或项目的上下文，搜索过去的笔记和决定，并保存所学内容，让下一次对话从上一次结束的地方继续。每位用户登录自己的 Cobrain 账号。

prompts.text: Load my Cobrain context for this project before we start.
prompts.zhText: 开始之前，请先加载我在 Cobrain 中的这个项目的上下文。

prompts.text: Search my Cobrain notes for what we decided about pricing.
prompts.zhText: 在我的 Cobrain 笔记中搜索我们关于定价的决定。

prompts.text: Save a note in Cobrain with what we did today and what is left.
prompts.zhText: 在 Cobrain 中保存一条笔记，记下我们今天做了什么、还剩什么。

plugins.name: Honcho
plugins.zhTagline: 跨 AI 工具的个人记忆
plugins.description: Honcho by Plastic Labs gives agents a long-term memory of you that other AI tools you connect can share. Agents save what they learn, and Honcho reasons over it to build a model of your preferences, goals and ways of working. Agents ask it questions before they start. OpenBot agents keep their own memory too; Honcho is the memory that follows you to other tools. Messages that agents save go to your Honcho account.
plugins.zhDescription: Plastic Labs 的 Honcho 为智能体提供关于你的长期记忆，你连接的其他 AI 工具也可以共享。智能体保存所学内容，Honcho 据此推理，构建你的偏好、目标和工作方式的模型。智能体在开始前会向它提问。OpenBot 智能体也有自己的记忆；Honcho 是跟随你到其他工具的记忆。智能体保存的消息会发送到你的 Honcho 账户。

prompts.text: Ask Honcho what it knows about how I like to work before we start.
prompts.zhText: 开始之前，问问 Honcho 它对我喜欢的工作方式了解多少。

prompts.text: Save the decisions from this thread to Honcho.
prompts.zhText: 把这个对话中的决定保存到 Honcho。

prompts.text: What does Honcho say about my writing style? Use it for this draft.
prompts.zhText: Honcho 对我的写作风格怎么说？把它用在这份草稿里。

plugins.name: Hindsight
plugins.description: Hindsight by Vectorize gives agents a long-term memory in Hindsight Cloud. Agents retain facts and events, recall them by meaning, time and entity, and reflect on them to form mental models. Memories are kept in banks, and agents can make a bank for each project or person. OpenBot agents keep their own memory too; Hindsight is the memory that other AI tools you connect can share. What agents retain goes to your Hindsight Cloud account.
plugins.zhDescription: Vectorize 的 Hindsight 为智能体提供 Hindsight Cloud 中的长期记忆。智能体保留事实和事件，按含义、时间和实体回忆它们，并对其进行反思以形成心智模型。记忆保存在记忆库中，智能体可以为每个项目或每个人创建一个记忆库。OpenBot 智能体也有自己的记忆；Hindsight 是你连接的其他 AI 工具可以共享的记忆。智能体保留的内容会发送到你的 Hindsight Cloud 账户。

prompts.text: Recall from Hindsight what we know about this project before we start.
prompts.zhText: 开始之前，从 Hindsight 中回忆我们对这个项目的了解。

prompts.text: Retain the decisions and open questions from this thread in Hindsight.
prompts.zhText: 把这个对话中的决定和未解决的问题保留到 Hindsight。

prompts.text: Reflect on my Hindsight memories: what patterns do you see in my last month of work?
prompts.zhText: 反思我在 Hindsight 中的记忆：你在我上个月的工作中看到了哪些规律？

plugins.name: Mem0
plugins.description: Mem0 gives agents a long-term memory in your Mem0 account. Agents add facts and preferences, search them by meaning, and update or delete them. Other AI tools that you connect to Mem0 share the same memories. To make Mem0 the only memory of an agent, turn off OpenBot memory in the agent's settings. What agents save goes to your Mem0 account.

prompts.text: Search Mem0 for what you know about my current projects before we start.
Add to Mem0 that I prefer short status updates with the open questions first.
List my Mem0 memories about the old office and delete the ones that are out of date.

plugins.name: Figma
plugins.description: Figma lets agents read design files, inspect components, styles and variables, and hand production specs to engineers. It connects to the MCP server in the Figma desktop app, on this computer. The server can read designs only; write support is in progress.
plugins.zhDescription: Figma 让助手读取设计文件、检查组件、样式与变量，并把生产规格交给工程师。它连接这台电脑上 Figma 桌面应用里的 MCP 服务器。该服务器目前只能读取设计，写入支持仍在开发中。
authSteps: Open the Figma desktop app and sign in. The server needs a Dev or Full seat on a paid plan.
Open a design file from a team project, not from Drafts.
Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows), search for "MCP", and turn on "Enable desktop MCP server".
Keep Figma open while agents use it.
plugins.authNote: The local server can only read designs: layout, code context, variables and screenshots. It cannot draw or edit yet. We are working on write support.

prompts.text: Hand off the checkout file: list screens, components, and styles.
prompts.zhText: 交接结算页文件：列出页面、组件和样式。

prompts.text: Audit this file for inconsistent spacing and color use.
prompts.zhText: 检查这个文件的间距和配色是否一致。

prompts.text: Extract the marketing icons at 2x for the app bundle.
prompts.zhText: 把营销图标按 2 倍导出，用于应用打包。

plugins.name: Paper
plugins.tagline: Design canvas built on HTML and CSS
plugins.zhTagline: 基于 HTML 与 CSS 的设计画布
plugins.description: Paper lets agents read and write the design file that is open in Paper Desktop: inspect artboards, selections, computed styles, JSX and tokens, and create or change frames, text and styles. Install Paper Desktop, open it once, and open a file before you start. OpenBot starts the Paper CLI that Paper Desktop installs. Paper needs no key. Write tools change the open file, so review each write before you approve it.
plugins.zhDescription: Paper 让助手读写 Paper Desktop 中打开的设计文件：检查画板、选区、计算样式、JSX 与 token，并创建或修改画框、文本和样式。请先安装 Paper Desktop，打开一次，并在开始前打开一个文件。OpenBot 会启动 Paper Desktop 安装的 Paper CLI。Paper 不需要密钥。写入类工具会改动当前文件，因此每次批准前请先核对。

prompts.text: Implement the selected Paper frame in this codebase, with our code conventions.
prompts.zhText: 按我们的代码规范，在这个代码库里实现选中的 Paper 画框。

prompts.text: Use the styles in this repository and design a settings page in Paper.
prompts.zhText: 用这个仓库里的样式，在 Paper 中设计一个设置页面。

prompts.text: List the design tokens in the open Paper file and compare them with our theme.
prompts.zhText: 列出打开的 Paper 文件中的设计 token，并与我们的主题对比。

plugins.name: Higgsfield
plugins.description: Higgsfield lets agents generate images, videos, characters and audio with Higgsfield models such as Seedance, Kling, Veo and MiniMax Hailuo, check the credit balance, and browse the Asset Library. Results are saved to the user's Higgsfield Assets. Each user signs in to their own Higgsfield account through the browser. Every generation uses credits of that account at standard rates, also on an unlimited plan.
plugins.zhDescription: Higgsfield 让助手使用 Seedance、Kling、Veo 和 MiniMax Hailuo 等 Higgsfield 模型生成图片、视频、角色和音频，查看积分余额，并浏览 Asset Library。结果保存到用户的 Higgsfield Assets。每个用户在浏览器中登录自己的 Higgsfield 账户。每次生成都按标准费率消耗该账户的积分，无限套餐也一样。

prompts.text: How many Higgsfield credits do I have?
prompts.zhText: 我还有多少 Higgsfield 积分？

prompts.text: Make a Higgsfield product photo of a ceramic mug on a wooden table.
prompts.zhText: 用 Higgsfield 生成一张陶瓷马克杯放在木桌上的产品照。

prompts.text: Make a 5-second Higgsfield video of waves at sunset.
prompts.zhText: 用 Higgsfield 生成一段 5 秒的日落海浪视频。

plugins.name: Sunra
plugins.description: Sunra lets agents make images, videos, audio and 3D models with models such as GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, FLUX, Seedance, Kling and Veo, check the credit balance, and read the results. Results go to a project in the user's Sunra account. Each user signs in to their own Sunra account through the browser. Sunra first quotes the cost of each generation, and spends credits of that account only after it is confirmed.
plugins.zhDescription: Sunra 让助手使用 GPT Image、Nano Banana、Seedream、FLUX、Seedance、Kling 和 Veo 等模型生成图片、视频、音频和 3D 模型，查看积分余额，并获取结果。结果保存到用户 Sunra 账户中的一个项目里。每个用户在浏览器中登录自己的 Sunra 账户。Sunra 会先报出每次生成的费用，确认后才消耗该账户的积分。

prompts.text: How many Sunra credits do I have?
prompts.zhText: 我还有多少 Sunra 积分？

prompts.text: Make a Sunra poster of a night market in the rain, in portrait format.
prompts.zhText: 用 Sunra 生成一张雨中夜市的竖版海报。

prompts.text: Make a 5-second Sunra video of a paper boat on a river. Tell me the cost first.
prompts.zhText: 用 Sunra 生成一段 5 秒的纸船在河上漂流的视频。先告诉我费用。

plugins.name: ElevenLabs
plugins.zhTagline: 语音、声音和语音智能体
plugins.description: ElevenLabs lets agents turn text into speech, work with voices, and create, test and review ElevenLabs voice agents and their conversations. Generated audio comes back as a short-lived download link. Each user signs in to their own ElevenLabs account through the browser, and each generation uses credits of that account.
plugins.zhDescription: ElevenLabs 让智能体把文本转成语音、使用各种声音，并创建、测试和查看 ElevenLabs 语音智能体及其对话。生成的音频以短时有效的下载链接返回。每位用户在浏览器中登录自己的 ElevenLabs 账号，每次生成都会使用该账号的额度。

prompts.text: Read this paragraph aloud with a calm ElevenLabs voice and give me the audio.
prompts.zhText: 用平静的 ElevenLabs 声音朗读这段文字，并把音频给我。

prompts.text: List my ElevenLabs voice agents and the voice each one uses.
prompts.zhText: 列出我的 ElevenLabs 语音智能体以及每个使用的声音。

prompts.text: Summarize the last ten conversations of my support voice agent.
prompts.zhText: 总结我的客服语音智能体最近十次对话。

plugins.name: Apple apps
plugins.tagline: Mail, Calendar and more on your Mac
plugins.description: Apple apps lets agents use Mail, Calendar, Contacts, Reminders, Notes, Messages and Safari on this Mac. It works on macOS only. OpenBot starts mcp-icloud, a community server that is not made by Apple or OpenBot. The server controls the apps through AppleScript, on this computer, and needs no account and no key. When you install it, OpenBot can ask macOS for access to all of these apps at once, with one prompt for each app. If you do not, macOS asks the first time an agent uses an app. To change this later, open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Automation. Agents can send email and iMessages, and change or delete events, contacts and reminders, so review each write before you approve it. What the tools read, such as email text, goes to the model provider of the agent.
plugins.zhDescription: Apple apps 让助手使用这台 Mac 上的邮件、日历、通讯录、提醒事项、备忘录、信息和 Safari。它仅适用于 macOS。OpenBot 会启动 mcp-icloud，这是一个社区服务器，不是 Apple 或 OpenBot 制作的。该服务器在这台电脑上通过 AppleScript 控制这些应用，不需要账号和密钥。安装时，OpenBot 可以一次性向 macOS 请求访问所有这些应用，每个应用显示一次提示。如果不这样做，macOS 会在助手第一次使用某个应用时询问。如需之后更改，打开系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 自动化。助手可以发送邮件和 iMessage，并修改或删除日程、联系人和提醒事项，因此请在批准前检查每次写入。工具读取的内容（例如邮件正文）会发送给助手的模型提供商。

prompts.text: Summarize my unread email in Apple Mail from today.
prompts.zhText: 总结我今天在 Apple 邮件中的未读邮件。

prompts.text: What is on my Apple Calendar today and tomorrow?
prompts.zhText: 我今天和明天的 Apple 日历上有什么安排？

prompts.text: Find the latest email about the project meeting and add the meeting to my calendar.
prompts.zhText: 找到关于项目会议的最新邮件，并把这个会议添加到我的日历中。

plugins.name: Sentry
plugins.description: Sentry lets agents search recent errors, inspect stack traces and affected releases, and summarize what broke after a deploy. Each user signs in to their own Sentry account through the browser.
plugins.zhDescription: Sentry 让助手搜索最近的错误、查看堆栈与受影响的版本，并总结发布后出了什么问题。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Sentry 账号。

prompts.text: What new errors appeared since yesterday's deploy?
prompts.zhText: 昨天发布之后出现了哪些新错误？

prompts.text: Explain the top crash in the mobile project and its likely cause.
prompts.zhText: 解释移动端项目中最严重的崩溃及其可能原因。

prompts.text: How healthy is the current release compared to the last one?
prompts.zhText: 当前版本的健康状况与上一个版本相比如何？

plugins.name: AppSignal
plugins.description: AppSignal lets agents search error incidents and stack traces, find slow actions and traces, read logs, metrics, check-ins and uptime monitors, and build dashboards. Each user signs in to their own AppSignal account through the browser. The sign-in gives all read and write tools, so agents can also change the state, severity and assignee of an incident and add notes.

prompts.text: Which new errors did my production app get since the last deploy?
Which actions were the slowest this week, and why?
Did any uptime monitor or check-in fail in the last 24 hours?

plugins.name: GitLab
plugins.description: GitLab lets agents search projects, read and create issues, review and update merge requests, read repository files and commits, and check CI pipelines and jobs on GitLab.com. Each user signs in to their own GitLab account through the browser. Agents get the same permissions as the user: they can push commits, change issues and merge requests, and merge them. For a self-hosted GitLab, add an MCP server with your GitLab address followed by /api/v4/mcp in the MCP servers settings, and sign in there.
plugins.zhDescription: GitLab 让助手在 GitLab.com 上搜索项目、阅读和创建 Issue、审查和更新合并请求、阅读仓库文件和提交，并检查 CI 流水线和作业。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 GitLab 账号。助手拥有与用户相同的权限：可以推送提交、修改 Issue 和合并请求，并执行合并。对于自托管的 GitLab，请在 MCP 服务器设置中添加一个服务器，地址为你的 GitLab 地址加上 /api/v4/mcp，然后在那里登录。

prompts.text: Which merge requests wait for my review?
prompts.zhText: 哪些合并请求在等我审查？

prompts.text: Why did the last pipeline on the default branch fail?
prompts.zhText: 默认分支上最近一次流水线为什么失败了？

prompts.text: File an issue for the crash in the sync queue with reproduction steps.
prompts.zhText: 为同步队列的崩溃建一个 Issue，附上复现步骤。

plugins.name: Vercel
plugins.description: Vercel lets agents list projects and recent deployments, read build and runtime logs, and find why a build failed. Each user signs in to their own Vercel account through the browser and chooses the teams that agents can use. In those teams, agents get the same rights as the user's account. They can also change environment variables, domains, DNS records and deployments, and buy domains.
plugins.zhDescription: Vercel 让助手列出项目和最近的部署、读取构建与运行时日志，并查明构建失败的原因。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Vercel 账号，并选择助手可用的团队。在这些团队中，助手拥有与该账号相同的权限，还可以修改环境变量、域名、DNS 记录和部署，以及购买域名。

prompts.text: Why did the last production deployment fail?
prompts.zhText: 上一次生产部署为什么失败？

prompts.text: List the deployments from today and their status.
prompts.zhText: 列出今天的部署及其状态。

prompts.text: Which routes had runtime errors in the last hour?
prompts.zhText: 过去一小时哪些路由出现了运行时错误？

plugins.name: Cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare lets agents list and manage Workers, DNS records, R2, D1 and KV through the Cloudflare API, query Workers logs, and search the Cloudflare docs. Each user signs in to their own Cloudflare account through the browser. On Cloudflare's consent page, choose Read only: the default, Minimal, does not let agents see Workers, logs or DNS records. With write permissions, agents can deploy and delete Workers, change DNS records and change other account settings.
plugins.zhDescription: Cloudflare 让助手通过 Cloudflare API 列出并管理 Workers、DNS 记录、R2、D1 和 KV，查询 Workers 日志，并搜索 Cloudflare 文档。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Cloudflare 账号。在 Cloudflare 的授权页面上，请选择 Read only：默认的 Minimal 不允许助手查看 Workers、日志或 DNS 记录。拥有写入权限时，助手可以部署和删除 Workers、修改 DNS 记录以及修改其他账号设置。

prompts.text: Which Workers are deployed in my Cloudflare account?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Cloudflare 账号中部署了哪些 Workers？

prompts.text: Which Cloudflare Workers logged errors in the last hour?
prompts.zhText: 过去一小时哪些 Cloudflare Workers 记录了错误？

prompts.text: List the DNS records of each zone in my Cloudflare account.
prompts.zhText: 列出我的 Cloudflare 账号中每个区域的 DNS 记录。

plugins.name: Supabase
plugins.zhTagline: 数据库、日志与 Edge Functions
plugins.description: Supabase lets agents list projects, run SQL, read table schemas and logs, check security and performance advisors, manage edge functions and branches, and search the Supabase docs. Each user signs in to their own Supabase account through the browser and chooses an organization. Agents get full access: they can run SQL that changes or deletes data, apply migrations, deploy edge functions, and create or pause projects.
plugins.zhDescription: Supabase 让助手列出项目、运行 SQL、读取表结构和日志、查看 advisors 的安全与性能建议、管理 Edge Functions 和分支，并搜索 Supabase 文档。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Supabase 账号并选择一个组织。助手拥有完全访问权限：可以运行修改或删除数据的 SQL、应用迁移、部署 Edge Functions，以及创建或暂停项目。

prompts.text: Which projects are in my Supabase organization?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Supabase 组织中有哪些项目？

prompts.text: List the tables and columns of my Supabase database.
prompts.zhText: 列出我的 Supabase 数据库中的表和列。

prompts.text: Which errors did my Supabase project log in the last hour?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Supabase 项目在过去一小时记录了哪些错误？

plugins.name: Neon
plugins.description: Neon lets agents list projects and branches, run SQL, read table schemas, test schema changes on a temporary branch, find slow queries, and search the Neon docs. Each user signs in to their own Neon account through the browser and can choose read-only access when they authorize. With full access, agents can run SQL that changes or deletes data, and create, reset or delete branches, databases and projects. Neon recommends its MCP server for development and testing, not for production databases.
plugins.zhDescription: Neon 让助手列出项目和分支、运行 SQL、读取表结构、在临时分支上测试结构变更、查找慢查询，并搜索 Neon 文档。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Neon 账号，并可在授权时选择只读访问。在完全访问模式下，助手可以运行修改或删除数据的 SQL，并创建、重置或删除分支、数据库和项目。Neon 建议将其 MCP 服务器用于开发和测试，而不是生产数据库。

prompts.text: Which projects and branches are in my Neon account?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Neon 账号中有哪些项目和分支？

prompts.text: Which queries are the slowest on my Neon database, and why?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Neon 数据库中哪些查询最慢？原因是什么？

prompts.text: Add an index on the orders table in a temporary branch, and show me the result before you apply it.
prompts.zhText: 在临时分支上为 orders 表添加索引，并在应用之前把结果给我看。

plugins.name: Prisma
plugins.tagline: Postgres databases, backups and Compute apps
plugins.zhTagline: Postgres 数据库、备份与 Compute 应用
plugins.description: Prisma lets agents list and create Prisma Postgres databases, read schemas, run SQL, list backups and restore them to a new database, manage Object Storage buckets, read Compute builds and logs, and search the Prisma docs. Each user signs in to their own Prisma account through the browser and selects a workspace. Agents get full access: they can run SQL that changes or deletes data, update schemas, delete databases and buckets, and stop, roll back or delete Compute deployments.
plugins.zhDescription: Prisma 让助手列出和创建 Prisma Postgres 数据库、读取数据库结构、运行 SQL、列出备份并将其恢复到新数据库、管理 Object Storage 存储桶、读取 Compute 构建和日志，并搜索 Prisma 文档。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Prisma 账号并选择一个工作区。助手拥有完全访问权限：可以运行修改或删除数据的 SQL、更新数据库结构、删除数据库和存储桶，以及停止、回滚或删除 Compute 部署。

prompts.text: Which databases are in my Prisma workspace?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Prisma 工作区中有哪些数据库？

prompts.text: Show me all available backups of my database.
prompts.zhText: 列出我的数据库所有可用的备份。

prompts.text: Show the runtime logs of my latest Compute deployment.
prompts.zhText: 显示我最新一次 Compute 部署的运行时日志。

plugins.name: Netlify
plugins.description: Netlify lets agents list projects and deploys, read edge request logs, create projects, and deploy code to an existing project. Each user signs in to their own Netlify account through the browser. Agents get the same access as the user's account: they can change environment variables, forms and visitor access, install or remove extensions, and delete form submissions and environment variables.
plugins.zhDescription: Netlify 让助手列出项目和部署、读取边缘请求日志、创建项目，并将代码部署到现有项目。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Netlify 账号。助手拥有与该账号相同的访问权限：可以修改环境变量、表单和访客访问设置，安装或移除扩展，以及删除表单提交和环境变量。

prompts.text: What is the status of the latest deploy of each of my Netlify projects?
prompts.zhText: 我的每个 Netlify 项目最新一次部署的状态是什么？

prompts.text: Which URLs of my site returned server errors in the last day?
prompts.zhText: 过去一天里，我的网站有哪些 URL 返回了服务器错误？

prompts.text: Deploy this folder to my existing Netlify project.
prompts.zhText: 把这个文件夹部署到我现有的 Netlify 项目。

plugins.name: Railway
plugins.description: Railway lets agents list projects and services, create projects, redeploy services, and manage feature flags. Agents can also give multi-step work to the Railway Agent, which reads logs, finds why a deploy failed, creates services and sets variables. Each user signs in to their own Railway account through the browser and chooses the workspaces and projects that agents can use. Agents get full access in those projects: they can deploy staged changes, delete feature flags, and change services, variables, databases and networking through the Railway Agent.
plugins.zhDescription: Railway 让助手列出项目和服务、创建项目、重新部署服务并管理功能开关。助手还可以把多步骤的工作交给 Railway Agent，它会读取日志、查明部署失败的原因、创建服务并设置变量。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Railway 账号，并选择助手可用的工作区和项目。在这些项目中，助手拥有完全访问权限：可以部署暂存的更改、删除功能开关，并通过 Railway Agent 修改服务、变量、数据库和网络。

prompts.text: Which projects and services are in my Railway workspace?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Railway 工作区里有哪些项目和服务？

prompts.text: Why does my backend service on Railway crash on deploy?
prompts.zhText: 我在 Railway 上的后端服务为什么在部署时崩溃？

prompts.text: Redeploy the API service in my Railway project.
prompts.zhText: 重新部署我 Railway 项目中的 API 服务。

plugins.name: Render
plugins.description: Render lets agents list workspaces and services, read logs, events and metrics, see the deploy history, trigger deploys, and run read-only SQL on Render Postgres. A Render API key goes into one Authorization header. The key reaches every workspace of the Render account. Agents can create web services, static sites, cron jobs, Postgres databases and Key Value instances, which can cost money, and they can replace the environment variables of a service. The server cannot delete a resource.
plugins.zhDescription: Render 让助手列出工作区和服务，读取日志、事件和指标，查看部署历史，触发部署，并在 Render Postgres 上运行只读 SQL。Render API 密钥放在一个 Authorization 请求头中。该密钥可访问 Render 账号的所有工作区。助手可以创建 Web 服务、静态网站、定时任务、Postgres 数据库和 Key Value 实例，这可能产生费用；助手还可以替换服务的环境变量。服务器无法删除任何资源。

prompts.text: Which services are in my Render workspace?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Render 工作区里有哪些服务？

prompts.text: Which errors did my Render web service log in the last hour?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Render Web 服务在过去一小时记录了哪些错误？

prompts.text: Why did the last deploy of my Render service fail?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Render 服务最近一次部署为什么失败？

plugins.name: Cloud 66
plugins.description: Cloud 66 lets agents list accounts, applications, servers and clouds, read deployments and their logs, start deployments, manage deployment profiles, and create Deploy v3 clusters. Each user signs in to their own Cloud 66 account through the browser and selects the permissions on the consent page. Agents cannot do more than the user's Cloud 66 role permits. Deploying and creating servers can cost money. To delete an application or a deployment profile, or to add a cloud, Cloud 66 asks the agent to show a confirmation link. When the chat cannot show it, do these actions in the Cloud 66 dashboard.

prompts.text: Which applications are in my Cloud 66 accounts?
Why did the last deployment of my app fail? Read its logs.
Deploy my staging application and tell me when it is done.

plugins.name: Context7
plugins.description: Context7 fetches current documentation and API references for libraries and frameworks, so answers use the version the project actually runs. It needs no account and no key.
plugins.zhDescription: Context7 获取库与框架的最新文档和 API 参考，让回答基于项目实际运行的版本。无需账号，也无需密钥。

prompts.text: What is the current API for virtualized lists in this framework?
prompts.zhText: 这个框架中虚拟列表当前的 API 是什么？

prompts.text: What changed between v2 and v3 of this router?
prompts.zhText: 这个路由的 v2 到 v3 之间有什么变化？

prompts.text: Show a current example for authenticated file uploads.
prompts.zhText: 给我一个当前可用的鉴权文件上传示例。

plugins.name: Hugging Face
plugins.tagline: Models, datasets and papers on the Hub
plugins.zhTagline: Hub 上的模型、数据集和论文
plugins.description: Hugging Face lets agents search models, datasets, Spaces, collections and papers on the Hugging Face Hub, read model cards and repository files, preview datasets, and search the Hugging Face documentation. It uses public Hub data and needs no account and no key. The tools only read: agents cannot create repositories or run jobs.
plugins.zhDescription: Hugging Face 让助手在 Hugging Face Hub 上搜索模型、数据集、Spaces、合集和论文，读取模型卡片和仓库文件，预览数据集，并搜索 Hugging Face 文档。它使用 Hub 的公开数据，无需账号和密钥。这些工具只读取数据：助手不能创建仓库，也不能运行任务。

prompts.text: Find small open models for speech recognition on Hugging Face.
prompts.zhText: 在 Hugging Face 上找一些用于语音识别的小型开放模型。

prompts.text: Which papers are trending on Hugging Face today?
prompts.zhText: 今天 Hugging Face 上有哪些热门论文？

prompts.text: Find a dataset of weather time series and show its columns.
prompts.zhText: 找一个天气时间序列数据集，并显示它的列。

plugins.name: Stripe
plugins.description: Stripe lets agents look up payments, customers, and invoices, and draft payment links, in the account the signed-in user can reach. Each user signs in to their own Stripe account through the browser.
plugins.zhDescription: Stripe 让助手在已登录用户可访问的账号中查询支付、客户和发票，并起草支付链接。每位用户通过浏览器登录自己的 Stripe 账号。

prompts.text: Look up this payment and explain why it failed.
prompts.zhText: 查询这笔支付并解释它为什么失败。

prompts.text: Summarize this customer's invoices and outstanding balance.
prompts.zhText: 总结该客户的发票和未结余额。

prompts.text: Draft a payment link for the Pro plan at 49 per month.
prompts.zhText: 为每月 49 的专业版套餐起草一个支付链接。

plugins.name: RevenueCat
plugins.description: RevenueCat lets agents read and change the setup of your in-app subscriptions: apps, products, entitlements, offerings, packages, paywalls and experiments. Agents can also look up customers and their purchases, and read charts and metrics. A RevenueCat secret API key goes into one Authorization header. The key reaches one project. With a read-only key, agents can only read. With a write key, agents can submit products to the App Store for review, grant entitlements to customers, and delete packages, targeting rules and webhooks.
plugins.zhDescription: RevenueCat 让智能体读取和更改应用内订阅的设置：应用、产品、权益、Offering、套餐、付费墙和实验。智能体还可以查找客户及其购买记录，并读取图表和指标。RevenueCat 密钥 API 密钥放在一个 Authorization 请求头中。该密钥可访问一个项目。使用只读密钥时，智能体只能读取。使用写入密钥时，智能体可以将产品提交到 App Store 审核、向客户授予权益，并删除套餐、定向规则和 Webhook。

authFields.label: API key
authFields.hint: In the RevenueCat dashboard, open API keys in your project and create a secret API key. A read-only key is enough to view data.

prompts.text: Which offerings and packages does my RevenueCat project have?
prompts.zhText: 我的 RevenueCat 项目有哪些 Offering 和套餐？

prompts.text: How did my RevenueCat revenue and active subscriptions change this month?
prompts.zhText: 本月我在 RevenueCat 的收入和活跃订阅有什么变化？

prompts.text: Which entitlements does this RevenueCat customer have, and when do they expire?
prompts.zhText: 这位 RevenueCat 客户有哪些权益，什么时候到期？

plugins.name: PostHog
plugins.description: PostHog lets agents query events and funnels, inspect feature flags, and summarize what changed after a release. A personal API key from the project settings goes into one Authorization header.
plugins.zhDescription: PostHog 让助手查询事件和漏斗、检查功能开关，并总结发布后的变化。把项目设置中的个人 API 密钥填入一个 Authorization 请求头即可。

authFields.label: Personal API key
authFields.hint: PostHog Project settings → Personal API keys

prompts.text: How does the signup funnel look for the last 14 days?
prompts.zhText: 最近 14 天的注册漏斗情况如何？

prompts.text: Which feature flags are enabled for this user?
prompts.zhText: 该用户启用了哪些功能开关？

prompts.text: Did activation change after last week's release?
prompts.zhText: 上周发布之后激活率有变化吗？

plugins.name: Airtable
plugins.description: Airtable lets agents list bases, read and update records, and summarize table contents. An API key from the account page is passed to the local server as one environment variable.
plugins.zhDescription: Airtable 让助手列出多维表格、读写记录并汇总表内容。把账号页面上的 API 密钥作为一个环境变量传给本地服务器即可。

prompts.text: What bases do I have access to?
prompts.zhText: 我能访问哪些多维表格？

prompts.text: Summarize the launch tracker table.
prompts.zhText: 总结一下发布跟踪表。

prompts.text: Mark the shipped features as done in the roadmap base.
prompts.zhText: 在路线图表中把已发布的功能标为完成。

plugins.name: Firecrawl
plugins.description: Firecrawl lets agents scrape pages, extract structured data, and search the web through one API. An API key from the Firecrawl dashboard is passed to the local server as one environment variable.
plugins.zhDescription: Firecrawl 让助手通过一个 API 抓取页面、提取结构化数据并搜索网络。把 Firecrawl 控制台中的 API 密钥作为一个环境变量传给本地服务器即可。

prompts.text: Extract the pricing table from this page as structured data.
prompts.zhText: 把该页面的价格表提取成结构化数据。

prompts.text: Research competitor pricing and cite each source page.
prompts.zhText: 调研竞品定价，并为每个来源页面标注引用。

prompts.text: What changed on our changelog page this month?
prompts.zhText: 这个月我们的更新日志页面有哪些变化？

plugins.name: Brave Search
plugins.description: Brave Search lets agents search the web and local results without tracking. An API key from the Brave Search API dashboard is passed to the local server as one environment variable.
plugins.zhDescription: Brave Search 让助手在无追踪的前提下搜索网络和本地结果。把 Brave Search API 控制台中的 API 密钥作为一个环境变量传给本地服务器即可。

authFields.label: API key
authFields.hint: Brave Search API dashboard → API keys

prompts.text: What are reviewers saying about this framework version?
prompts.zhText: 评测者对这个框架版本有什么评价？

prompts.text: Find today's announcements for this product area.
prompts.zhText: 找找今天这个产品领域的公告。

prompts.text: Compare these two vendors with cited sources.
prompts.zhText: 对比这两家供应商，并附上来源。

plugins.name: Resend
plugins.description: Resend lets agents send transactional email and check delivery through one API. An API key from the Resend dashboard is passed to the local server as one environment variable.
plugins.zhDescription: Resend 让助手通过一个 API 发送事务性邮件并检查投递情况。把 Resend 控制台中的 API 密钥作为一个环境变量传给本地服务器即可。

prompts.text: Send the launch announcement draft to the beta list.
prompts.zhText: 把发布公告草稿发送到内测名单。

prompts.text: Did the invoice email reach the customer?
prompts.zhText: 发票邮件送达客户了吗？

prompts.text: Draft a password-reset email for the new flow.
prompts.zhText: 为新流程起草一封密码重置邮件。

plugins.name: Omnisend
plugins.description: Omnisend lets agents read campaign and form reports, find contacts and segments, and create and edit campaigns, automations, email templates, forms and products. Each user connects with an API key from their own Omnisend account. Agents can do what the key allows, which can include sending campaigns and deleting data.
plugins.zhDescription: Omnisend 让智能体读取活动和表单报告，查找联系人和细分，并创建和编辑活动、自动化流程、邮件模板、表单和商品。每位用户使用自己 Omnisend 账号中的 API 密钥连接。智能体可以执行该密钥允许的操作，可能包括发送活动和删除数据。

authFields.label: API key
authFields.hint: In Omnisend, open Store settings > API keys and create a key.

prompts.text: How did last week's campaigns perform compared to the week before?
prompts.zhText: 上周的活动与前一周相比效果如何？

prompts.text: How many contacts are in the VIP segment, and how did it change this month?
prompts.zhText: VIP 细分中有多少联系人，本月有什么变化？

prompts.text: Draft a campaign for the new collection, but do not send it.
prompts.zhText: 为新系列起草一个活动，但不要发送。

plugins.name: Postiz
plugins.description: Postiz lets agents list your social media channels, and draft, schedule and publish posts on more than 30 networks, such as X, LinkedIn, Instagram and TikTok. Agents can also upload media and make AI images and videos. Sign in to your Postiz account through the browser, or paste the API key from Settings › Developers in Postiz. All Postiz cloud plans include API access. Agents can publish a post immediately, so review each post before you approve it.
plugins.zhDescription: Postiz 让智能体列出你的社交媒体频道，并在 X、LinkedIn、Instagram、TikTok 等 30 多个平台上起草、排程和发布帖子。智能体还可以上传媒体，并用 AI 生成图片和视频。在浏览器中登录你的 Postiz 账户，或粘贴 Postiz 中 Settings › Developers 里的 API 密钥。所有 Postiz 云端方案都包含 API 访问权限。智能体可以立即发布帖子，因此请在批准前检查每个帖子。

prompts.text: Which social media channels are connected to Postiz?
prompts.zhText: 哪些社交媒体频道已连接到 Postiz？

prompts.text: Which posts are scheduled for next week?
prompts.zhText: 下周排程了哪些帖子？

prompts.text: Draft a LinkedIn post about our new release, but do not schedule it.
prompts.zhText: 起草一篇关于我们新版本的 LinkedIn 帖子，但不要排程。

plugins.name: TryPost
plugins.description: TryPost lets agents list your connected channels, and draft, schedule, queue and publish posts on X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest and more. Agents can also read analytics, manage ideas and approvals, and set posting times. Sign in to your TryPost account through the browser and choose a workspace. Agents can publish a post immediately, so review each post before you approve it.
plugins.zhDescription: TryPost 让智能体列出你已连接的频道，并在 X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook、TikTok、YouTube、Threads、Bluesky、Mastodon、Pinterest 等平台起草、排程、加入队列和发布帖子。智能体还可以查看分析数据、管理想法和审批，并设置发布时间。在浏览器中登录你的 TryPost 账户并选择一个工作区。智能体可以立即发布帖子，因此请在批准前检查每篇帖子。

prompts.text: Which posts are scheduled for this week?
prompts.zhText: 本周排程了哪些帖子？

prompts.text: Draft a LinkedIn post about our new release, but do not schedule it.
prompts.zhText: 起草一篇关于我们新版本的 LinkedIn 帖子，但不要排程。

prompts.text: Which of my posts from last month had the most engagement?
prompts.zhText: 上个月我的哪些帖子互动最多？

plugins.name: Composio
plugins.tagline: Gmail, Slack, GitHub and 1,000+ more apps
plugins.description: Composio connects your agents to Gmail, Slack, GitHub and more than 1,000 other apps through one MCP server. Sign in with your Composio account. When an agent needs an app, it asks you to connect that app.
plugins.zhDescription: Composio 通过一个 MCP 服务器把你的助手连接到 Gmail、Slack、GitHub 等 1000 多款应用。使用 Composio 账号登录。助手需要某个应用时，会请你连接该应用。

prompts.text: Summarize my unread email and draft replies to the urgent ones.
prompts.zhText: 总结我的未读邮件，并为紧急的几封起草回复。

prompts.text: Post a summary of this pull request to our team channel.
prompts.zhText: 把这个拉取请求的摘要发到我们的团队频道。

prompts.text: Which apps and actions can you use through Composio?
prompts.zhText: 通过 Composio 你能使用哪些应用和操作？

plugins.name: ClickUp
plugins.description: ClickUp lets agents search tasks, docs, comments and chat, create and update tasks, lists and docs, post comments, send chat messages and track time. Each user signs in to their own ClickUp account through the browser. Agents get the same permissions as the user. They can move tasks to the trash and delete comments.
plugins.zhDescription: ClickUp 让智能体搜索任务、文档、评论和聊天，创建和更新任务、列表和文档，发表评论，发送聊天消息并记录时间。每个用户在浏览器中登录自己的 ClickUp 账户。智能体拥有与用户相同的权限。它们可以把任务移到回收站，也可以删除评论。

prompts.text: Find my open ClickUp tasks due this week.
prompts.zhText: 找出我本周到期且未完成的 ClickUp 任务。

prompts.text: Create a ClickUp task for these action items and assign it to me.
prompts.zhText: 用这些待办事项创建一个 ClickUp 任务，并分配给我。

prompts.text: Find the latest project update in ClickUp and summarize the open questions.
prompts.zhText: 在 ClickUp 中找到最新的项目进展，并总结未解决的问题。

plugins.name: Coinbase
plugins.zhTagline: 加密货币价格、投资组合和交易
plugins.description: Coinbase lets agents read prices, balances, portfolios, orders and fees in Coinbase Advanced Trade, preview and place orders, convert between assets, and move funds between portfolios. Each user signs in to their own Coinbase account through the browser. Agents get the same permissions as the user. Orders and conversions use real funds, and agents can pay for x402 requests from the USDC balance.
plugins.zhDescription: Coinbase 让智能体读取 Coinbase Advanced Trade 中的价格、余额、投资组合、订单和费用，预览并下单，在资产之间兑换，并在投资组合之间转移资金。每个用户在浏览器中登录自己的 Coinbase 账户。智能体拥有与用户相同的权限。订单和兑换使用真实资金，智能体还可以用 USDC 余额支付 x402 请求。

prompts.text: What are my Coinbase balances in each portfolio?
prompts.zhText: 我在 Coinbase 每个投资组合中的余额是多少？

prompts.text: Show the BTC-USD price on Coinbase and how it moved this week.
prompts.zhText: 显示 Coinbase 上的 BTC-USD 价格以及本周的走势。

prompts.text: Preview a 50 USD market buy of ETH on Coinbase. Do not place the order.
prompts.zhText: 在 Coinbase 上预览一笔 50 USD 的 ETH 市价买入。不要下单。

plugins.name: Robinhood
plugins.zhTagline: 证券账户和智能体交易
plugins.description: Robinhood lets agents read the accounts, positions, balances, transaction history and watchlists of a Robinhood customer, read market data, and place stock, options and crypto orders. Each user signs in to their own Robinhood account through the browser. At the first sign-in, Robinhood asks the user to open a separate Agentic account. Agents can trade only in that account, and by default they place orders without asking the user to approve each one.
plugins.zhDescription: Robinhood 让智能体读取 Robinhood 客户的账户、持仓、余额、交易记录、自选列表和市场数据，并下达股票、期权和加密货币订单。每个用户在浏览器中登录自己的 Robinhood 账户。首次登录时，Robinhood 会要求用户开设一个单独的 Agentic 账户。智能体只能在该账户中交易，并且默认下单时不会逐笔请求用户批准。

prompts.text: Summarize my Robinhood positions and how they moved today.
prompts.zhText: 总结我在 Robinhood 的持仓以及今天的变动。

prompts.text: How did each stock on my Robinhood watchlist move this week?
prompts.zhText: 我在 Robinhood 自选列表中的每只股票本周走势如何？

prompts.text: How much cash is in my Robinhood Agentic account?
prompts.zhText: 我的 Robinhood Agentic 账户里有多少现金？

plugins.name: 1inch
plugins.description: 1inch lets agents search the 1inch Business API documentation and read SDK code examples for swaps, limit orders, and other integrations. Documentation search and SDK examples need no account and no key.

prompts.text: How do I get a swap quote with the 1inch API? Show the request parameters.
Show the SDK example for creating a limit order.
Which chains does the 1inch Swap API support?

plugins.name: 21st
plugins.description: 21st lets agents search a catalog of React UI components and add the chosen components to the project. Each user signs in to their own 21st account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find a pricing table component that fits this landing page.
Add a responsive navigation bar component to the header.
Show three date picker components and compare their props.

plugins.name: 2Chat
plugins.description: 2Chat lets agents read WhatsApp and SMS conversations, look up and add contacts, and draft replies on the 2Chat numbers of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own 2Chat account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize the WhatsApp conversations that have no reply yet.
Add a contact for Ana Ruiz with her phone number and company.
Draft a reply to the last message from this customer about the delivery date.

plugins.name: Adobe Analytics
plugins.description: Adobe Analytics lets agents find report suites, dimensions, metrics, segments and Workspace projects, and run ranked and trended reports. Each user signs in with their own Adobe ID through the browser and selects an organization. An Adobe administrator must first give the account MCP Read-only Access or MCP Full Access. With MCP Full Access, agents can also create and update segments, calculated metrics, date ranges and Workspace projects.

prompts.text: Which pages had the most visits last week?
Show the daily orders for this month and compare them with last month.
Which segments do we have for mobile visitors, and how are they defined?

plugins.name: Adspirer
plugins.description: Adspirer lets agents read campaign performance and draft campaign changes across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and TikTok Ads accounts that the user connects in Adspirer. Each user signs in to their own Adspirer account through the browser.

prompts.text: How did my Google Ads campaigns perform last week compared to the week before?
Which keywords spent the most this month with no conversions?
Draft three new ad headlines for the spring sale campaign.

plugins.name: Affinity
plugins.description: Affinity lets agents search people, companies, and opportunities, read notes and interaction history, and update lists in the CRM of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Affinity account through the browser.

prompts.text: Who on my team has the strongest connection to this company?
Summarize the deals in my pipeline list that had no contact in 30 days.
Prepare a brief on this founder from our notes and past emails.

plugins.name: AgentMail
plugins.description: AgentMail lets agents create email inboxes, read threads, and draft and send messages from those inboxes. Each user signs in to their own AgentMail account through the browser.

prompts.text: Create an inbox for the support agent.
Summarize the unread threads in the support inbox.
Draft a reply to the latest message in the billing thread.

plugins.name: Ahrefs
plugins.description: Ahrefs lets agents research keywords, backlinks, organic traffic, and competitor sites with Ahrefs data. Each user signs in to their own Ahrefs account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find low-difficulty keywords about home espresso machines.
Which pages bring the most organic traffic to this competitor?
List the new backlinks to our site in the last 30 days.

plugins.name: Airwallex
plugins.description: Airwallex lets agents read balances and transactions, build cashflow reports, create beneficiaries, and issue cards in the production account of the signed-in user. Each user signs in to their own Airwallex account through the browser.

prompts.text: What are my balances in each currency today?
Build a cashflow report for last month.
Which cards had the most spend this quarter?

plugins.name: Akiflow
plugins.description: Akiflow lets agents read and add tasks, plan the day, and check calendar events in the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Akiflow account through the browser.

prompts.text: What is on my plan for today?
Add a task to review the contract draft on Friday morning.
Where do I have two free hours this week for deep work?

plugins.name: Aleph
plugins.description: Aleph lets agents query the financial data, reports, and models of the signed-in user's Aleph workspace. Each user signs in to their own Aleph account through the browser.

prompts.text: Explain the variance between budget and actuals for last quarter.
What is our monthly burn rate for the last six months?
Draft a summary of revenue and margin trends for the board pack.

plugins.name: Algolia
plugins.description: Algolia lets agents search indices, read and update index settings, and check search analytics in the applications that the signed-in user can access. Each user signs in to their own Algolia account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which search queries returned no results last week?
Show the searchable attributes and ranking settings of the products index.
Search the products index for 'running shoes' and explain the ranking.

plugins.name: Allo
plugins.description: Allo lets agents read call transcripts and SMS, look up and update contacts, and draft text messages in the signed-in workspace. Each user signs in to their own Allo account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which calls did I miss today, and what did the callers want?
Summarize my last call with this customer.
Update the contact for Tom Becker with his new company name.

plugins.name: Alpha Vantage
plugins.description: Alpha Vantage lets agents look up stock prices, company fundamentals, forex and crypto rates, economic indicators, and technical indicators. Each user signs in to their own Alpha Vantage account through the browser.

prompts.text: What is the latest price and daily change for MSFT?
Compare the last four quarters of earnings for AAPL and GOOGL.
Show the 14-day RSI for NVDA over the last month.

plugins.name: Amplemarket
plugins.description: Amplemarket lets agents find and research leads, enrich companies and contacts, review outreach activity, and add leads to lists in the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Amplemarket account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find heads of finance at logistics companies in Germany with 200 to 1,000 employees.
Research this company: tech stack, recent hires, and funding.
What were our past touchpoints with this email address?

plugins.name: Amplitude
plugins.description: Amplitude lets agents query events, charts, dashboards, and experiments in the projects that the signed-in user can access. Each user signs in to their own Amplitude account through the browser.

prompts.text: How did week-one retention change after the last release?
Where do users drop off in the signup funnel?
Summarize the results of the running checkout experiment.

plugins.name: Ando
plugins.description: Ando lets agents join a workspace as a member, read channels and threads, and post messages. Each user signs in to their own Ando account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize what happened in the product channel today.
Which threads mention me and still need an answer?
Draft a status update for the launch thread.

plugins.name: Apify
plugins.description: Apify lets agents search the Apify Store, run Actors that scrape and extract web data, and read the results. Each user signs in to their own Apify account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find an Actor that extracts reviews from Google Maps.
Scrape the product names and prices from this category page.
Show the results of my last Actor run.

plugins.name: Apollo
plugins.description: Apollo lets agents search B2B contacts and companies, enrich records, and review sequences in the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Apollo account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find VPs of engineering at fintech companies in London.
Enrich this list of companies with size, industry, and location.
Which of my sequences had the best reply rate this month?

plugins.name: Artie
plugins.description: Artie lets agents create, check, and manage the real-time database replication pipelines of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Artie account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which of my pipelines have errors or lag right now?
List the tables that the Postgres pipeline replicates to Snowflake.
Help me set up a pipeline from our MySQL database to BigQuery.

plugins.name: Atlan
plugins.description: Atlan lets agents search data assets, read lineage and ownership, and update asset metadata with the signed-in user's permissions. Each user signs in to their own Atlan account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which table holds the certified revenue numbers?
Show the upstream lineage of the monthly churn dashboard.
Who owns the orders table, and which dashboards use it?

plugins.name: Attio
plugins.description: Attio lets agents search records, update deals, log notes, and create tasks in the workspace of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Attio account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which open deals had no activity in the last two weeks?
Log a note on the Acme deal with the points from today's call.
Create a task to follow up with this contact next Tuesday.

plugins.name: AWS Knowledge
plugins.description: AWS Knowledge lets agents search and read current AWS documentation, and check which services and features are available in each AWS Region. It needs no account and no key.

prompts.text: Is Amazon Bedrock available in eu-central-1?
What does the AWS documentation recommend for S3 bucket access control?
What are the default Lambda concurrency limits, and how do I raise them?

plugins.name: Base44
plugins.description: Base44 lets agents create and manage Base44 projects, edit an app's code in its sandbox, and call the Base44 platform API. Each user signs in to their own Base44 account through the browser.

prompts.text: List my Base44 apps and when each one changed last.
Create a Base44 app for booking meeting rooms.
Fix the form validation on the signup page of my app.

plugins.name: Basecamp
plugins.description: Basecamp lets agents read projects and message threads, add to-dos, and post updates with the access the signed-in user already has. Each user signs in to their own Basecamp account through the browser.

prompts.text: Catch me up on the website redesign project this week.
Which to-dos assigned to me are overdue?
Add a to-do to review the launch checklist by Thursday.

plugins.name: beehiiv
plugins.description: beehiiv lets agents read posts, subscribers, and performance data, and draft posts in the publications of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own beehiiv account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which of my last ten posts had the best open and click rates?
How did my subscriber count change this month, and from which sources?
Draft a post that announces our new pricing.

plugins.name: Better Stack
plugins.description: Better Stack lets agents check monitors and incidents, query logs and metrics, and read on-call schedules in the signed-in team. Each user signs in to their own Better Stack account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which incidents are open, and what caused them?
Find the most frequent errors in the API logs in the last hour.
Who is on call this weekend?

plugins.name: Bird
plugins.description: Bird lets agents send email, SMS, and WhatsApp messages, verify domains, manage numbers, and inspect message delivery in the workspace of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Bird account through the browser.

prompts.text: Why did the last password reset email to this address fail?
Check the DNS records for our sending domain and tell me what is missing.
Send a test SMS to my own number with the new template.

plugins.name: Blotato
plugins.description: Blotato lets agents draft, schedule, and publish posts to the social accounts that the user connects in Blotato. Each user signs in to their own Blotato account through the browser.

prompts.text: Draft a LinkedIn post from this blog article.
Schedule this post for Tuesday at 9:00 on my X account.
What posts are scheduled for this week?

plugins.name: Brex
plugins.description: Brex lets agents look up expenses, users, cards, banking transactions, and bills in the account of the signed-in user. Each user signs in to their own Brex account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which of my expenses this month are missing receipts?
Summarize card spend by team for last quarter.
Which bills are due in the next two weeks?

plugins.name: Bright Data
plugins.description: Bright Data lets agents search the web, read pages as Markdown, and collect structured data from public sites through Bright Data's unblocking and browser infrastructure. Each user signs in to their own Bright Data account through the browser, and requests use that account's quota.

prompts.text: Search the web for recent reviews of this product and summarize them.
Read this page as Markdown and list the prices it shows.
Collect the public pricing pages of these three competitors and compare the plans.

plugins.name: Browserless
plugins.description: Browserless lets agents open pages in a hosted browser, read their content, take screenshots, and make PDFs, also on sites that need JavaScript. Each user signs in to their own Browserless account through the browser.

prompts.text: Open this page in a browser and give me its main text.
Take a full-page screenshot of our pricing page.
Make a PDF of this article.

plugins.name: Buffer
plugins.description: Buffer lets agents read connected channels, the post queue, drafts and ideas, read post analytics, and draft, schedule or edit posts. Each user signs in to their own Buffer account through the browser.

prompts.text: What is in my Buffer queue for this week?
Draft a LinkedIn post about our new release and save it as a Buffer draft.
Which of my posts from last month had the most engagement?

plugins.name: Buildkite
plugins.description: Buildkite lets agents read pipelines, builds, jobs, logs and test results, and find why a build failed, in the organizations of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Buildkite account through the browser.

prompts.text: Why did the latest build on main fail?
Which tests failed most often in the last week of builds?
Show the status of the open builds for this branch.

plugins.name: Calendly
plugins.description: Calendly lets agents check availability, look up scheduled events and invitees, and manage event types and booking links. Each user signs in to their own Calendly account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which Calendly meetings do I have this week?
When am I free for a 30-minute meeting on Thursday?
Give me the booking link for my intro call event type.

plugins.name: Cartesia
plugins.description: Cartesia lets agents turn text into speech, transcribe audio, and list, clone and localize voices. Each user signs in to their own Cartesia account through the browser, and each generation uses credits of that account.

prompts.text: Read this paragraph aloud with a warm Cartesia voice and give me the audio.
List the Cartesia voices that speak German.
Transcribe this audio file.

plugins.name: Circleback
plugins.description: Circleback lets agents search meetings, read notes, transcripts and action items, and look up the people and companies in them. Each user signs in to their own Circleback account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize my last meeting with Acme and its action items.
Find where pricing came up in this month's meeting transcripts.
Which action items assigned to me are still open?

plugins.name: Clarify
plugins.description: Clarify lets agents read signals, time series and events from the industrial data of the signed-in Clarify organization. Each user signs in to their own Clarify account through the browser.

prompts.text: How did the temperature signals at this site change over the last 24 hours?
Which signals moved outside their normal range this week?
Find the signals that measure pump pressure.

plugins.name: Clerk
plugins.description: Clerk lets agents create and configure Clerk applications, view authentication settings, manage users, and check the DNS records of production instances. Each user signs in to their own Clerk account through the browser.

prompts.text: List my Clerk applications and their instances.
Who signed up to my development instance this week?
Which DNS records does my production instance still need?

plugins.name: ClickHouse Cloud
plugins.description: ClickHouse Cloud lets agents list services, databases and tables, run read-only SELECT queries, and read backups, ClickPipes and costs. Each user signs in to their own ClickHouse Cloud account through the browser, and the remote MCP server must be turned on for each service.

prompts.text: Which tables are in the analytics database of my production service?
How many events per day did we store last week?
What did my ClickHouse Cloud organization cost last month?

plugins.name: Close
